review:
A dark jungle on 5x4 with the Cut Reel: winning symbols and everything below them get cut away and the reels drop. A progression bar collects symbols through five levels, each adding free spins.

Three Soul Wilds have their own collectors, gathering souls from dropped premium symbols. Ayahuasca Spins lead into the top-tier Tzantza Spins. Rated Insane – Nolimit's highest – with a 15,950x max. Not one for short sessions.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
